1479-5700-5701-6517-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6517-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-3875-7090-8345.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}
Repeat.

7084-7272-7885.easyPrerequisites:
Down in the Valley's second chapter ability has resolved.
You control a land.
7084-7272-7885.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7272-7885.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

619-1432-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
619-1432-2645-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4681-5170-8095-8175.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

34-147-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-5147.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-3899-5626-5687.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5879-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Walking Archive.
When Walking Archive dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5879-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

643-1486-2757-6291.easyPrerequisites: There's a basic land on the battlefield.
643-1486-2757-6291.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, which is a Dwarf due to Maskwood Nexus.
Magda triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

567-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
567-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

413-1580-4871-6112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Fumulus and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

670-1619-3991-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6139.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from exile to the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

1385-2173-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1069-1169-1232-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1169-1232-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2781-4605-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying its mana cost.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-2307-6753.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve the Corsair Captain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2781-4681-5686.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

149-2757-5488--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-2757-5488--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-5231-6972--112.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
911-5231-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1636-2034-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-2034-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

315-4316-4465--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2510-3532-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2510-3532-5078-5402.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

277-1315-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp, that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
277-1315-5721-6883.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

261-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
261-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2921-4558-4863.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eleven tapped lands.
2091-2921-4558-4863.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Revolutionist.
Repeat.

373-877-4484-5686.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" or "Dragon" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-4484-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ebondeath
Repeat.

2136-2816-3621-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Orthion.
2136-2816-3621-4050.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token, adding {R}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Orthion by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Optionally, if you have an additional {R}{R} available, you may use Orthion's second ability once you have a large amount of {C} to get infinite {R}, which can then be used to activate Orthion infinitely targeting any other creature(s).

1992-4050-4802.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1992-4050-4802.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat.

112-565-3908.notablePrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
112-565-3908.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Spark Double.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Spark Double that enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Spark Double.
Orvar and the Spark Double token trigger, creating two token copies of Spark Double that enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting any Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
Orvar, Spark Double and the three Spark Double tokens trigger, creating five token copies of the Island.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate four of the Island tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.
Once you have infinite mana, you can then target any permanent using Clockspinning to get infinite tokens of them.

3090-4691-5076.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving an opponent control of Vilis.
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Kederekt Parasite triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

2972-3750-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Ganax does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent cannot block and kill Ganax.
2972-3750-4711.description:
Declare Ganax as an attacker.
Ganax's myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Put all Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, triggering each Ganax a number of times equal to the number of tokens created.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2744-3062-3693-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Walking Ballista.
Walking Ballista has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2744-3062-3693-3828.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.

404-1521-2105-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-2105-4359.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.
